name: @feimacode/open-design-agent-kit-chatgpt-plugin
description: Builds the Open Design ChatGPT desktop plugin (open-design-chatgpt-plugin-<version>.zip): OpenAI's portable plugin.json, the same skills as Codex's .agents/skills, a stdio mcp.json and the bundled server, run on plain node. Takes packages/mcp-server's version; never published to npm, attached to each GitHub release.
